purpose: One bounded language-development comparison on the first scenario-binding-qualified route-change episode. This tests whether checked P communicates the supported plan-change mechanism and unresolved trigger more faithfully than the fair tool-enabled R baseline before any candidate freeze.

development_cluster.broad_outcome: successful recorded plan change with unresolved physical trigger

question.text: What changed during this navigation action, what does the evidence establish about why it changed, and what remains unresolved?

method_comparison.P: checked geometric diagnostic plus v2 realization prompt plus bounded-diagnostic-language-v4 verification/fallback
method_comparison.R: repository-aware gpt-6-sol high agent with the same blind fixture, exact permitted source repositories, and the same executable diagnostic wrapper
method_comparison.T: deterministic rendering of the same checked diagnostic result
method_comparison.N: runtime/source presentation without decoded geometric diagnostic computation

evidence_boundary.methods_receive: the governed robot-visible fixture, exact permitted CRANE/core source, and the same executable geometric diagnostic tool; P additionally receives only the checked robot-visible diagnostic result produced by that tool
methods_do_not_receive: catalog layout identity or semantic obstacle truth
evaluator-only geometry, intervention identity, or simulator truth
the expected broad outcome from this declaration
required_withholding: which physical obstacle triggered the route change
controller consumption of every delivered plan

paper_value_decision.why_now: The physical episode already exists and passed fail-closed build, scenario-binding, leakage, and independent-reference checks. Three fixed calls can determine whether this candidate produces useful causal restraint on a valid route-change case before spending more collection or annotation resources.
paper_value_decision.relative_to_another_episode: This comparison is cheaper and tests the end-to-end language bottleneck, but it adds no independent physical evidence. Another independent governed episode remains more valuable after this fixed gate.
paper_value_decision.relative_to_annotation: No Luna call is authorized because an explicit blinded packet and independent required-unit inventory must be registered separately after outputs exist.
paper_value_decision.relative_to_statistics_figures_and_manus: One unannotated development cluster cannot support an effect estimate, figure, or paper conclusion; it is only a candidate-readiness diagnostic.
paper_value_decision.stop_rule: After the single R/P/N calls and deterministic T output, retain the result and stop. Do not revise prompts, retry, or add a favorable case based on the answers.

allowed_use: Development-only candidate assessment and response-quality audit. Not confirmation, replication, significance evidence, or authorization to freeze P/R.
decision_rule: Inspect whether P preserves the supported plan-change diagnosis and required causal limits relative to tool-enabled R. Regardless of direction, retain the result. A later Luna evaluation requires a separate prospective declaration and cannot activate confirmation from this one cluster.
